about: What a player finished, in plain words, for an app pump (docs/plan.md slice 31; the hub report's "Decided here": the engine keeps its 11 quest kinds and its shared test data, the apps show plain words that map onto them). Each kind's words are contract/copy/en.json's pump.kind.<key> (A quest, A match, A level, A boss fight, A stream, A work block: six since slice 33, which added the stream a player finished, on Twitch among others) and its family one of contract/library.json's families, which the engine composes the pump for, the coach's ask names and contract/fixtures/engine.json pins; the kinds keep this order on every screen. Both phones' Start a pump window and both watches' kinds read it (the apps bundle it), each game link of contract/links.json names one (slice 33), and tools/copytext.py --check fails on a kind without its words, with a family the library lacks or with a key or a family another kind has. Three keys go where a kind's key goes and are never a kind here: quick, the Quick pump's (2026-10-07: one tap, no kind, no family, the engine's Small pump that no quest flavours; the cores' PumpKinds.quick), which a watch's relay and a device's own record carry, and move, since slice 36 a move the player started from a step's card or a move's window (one move at tier 1, as the Quick pump is: tools/apppump.lua's A.pick beside A.quick), which a device's own record carries (no watch runs one), and since slice 51 expedition, an expedition's round (each round one app pump the engine composes with no family, as the Quick pump's: docs/plan.md slice 51), which a device's own record and a watch's relay of a phone's round carry; tools/copytext.py --check refuses a kind keyed quick, move or expedition. Since slice 67 work is also work mode's pump (A work block, at tier 2, sized by its place in the set: contract/fixtures/engine.json): one a work ask opens, or its Later composes without a screen, banks, its Later, its Bank all and its Bank the rest owing its moves as a match pump's do (slices 58 and 61), while a work pump the player picks by hand from Start a pump banks nothing (call 4): what banks is the pump's origin, never its kind.
